posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.text: The failing New York Times wrote about the “settling of a sexual harassment suit brought years ago by a waitress at President Trump’s golf club in Bedminster, N.J.” What they fail to say is that it did not involve President Trump, a rather important omission. FAKE NEWS!!!

posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.text: The New York Times incorrectly reported that “Mr. Trump called into the premier of a C-Span show, APPARENTLY WITHOUT NOTICE.” This is WRONG. It was a fully scheduled call, as a favor to C-Span, set up through White House Communications. It was done at C-Span’s request, not mine. The Times knew this, but lied, in order to demean - But this is the least of their lies!

posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.text: A Huge Victory against Fake News BBC, a terrible abuser of the truth, just handed down by highly respected District Court Judge, Jeffrey T. Kuntz, of the Southern District of Florida. In his powerful ruling, Judge Kuntz wrote, “Here, the news entity created the story. BBC admitted as much by confirming it had edited a video to make it appear as though President Trump made a statement he never made.” We will continue fighting against, and defeating, all of those who try to deceive the American People! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP

posts.text: The Democrats’ attempt to impeach Secretary of War Pete Hegseth has miserably FAILED! Every single Republican, except Thomas Massie, a major LOSER, voted in favor of Pete. posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.text: I am pleased to nominate James Sullivan to serve as Judge on the United States District Court for the Western District of Texas. James is a Justice on the Supreme Court of Texas and, previously, was General Counsel to Governor Greg Abbott, and Assistant Solicitor General of Texas. Additionally, Senators Ted Cruz and John Cornyn highly recommend him! After graduating from Harvard Law School and Rice University, James clerked for Judge Thomas Griffith of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the D.C. Circuit.
